requirements.title: Canonical readiness policy
requirements.description: When a readiness decision is prepared, deployment-manager shall evaluate one versioned policy registry and shall reject duplicate, drifted, or incomplete criteria.

validation.notes: The embedded 33-criterion policy is schema- and semantics-validated and its projection drift check is executable.

requirements.title: Immutable readiness review
requirements.description: When a candidate review is prepared or retried, deployment-manager shall derive one immutable identity and shall persist review evidence, findings, human checks, waivers, goal linkage, approval, and publication as distinct state.

validation.notes: Repository tests prove deterministic identity, separated lifecycle state, invalidation, typed observations, human checks, waivers, approval, promotion, and supersession constraints.

requirements.title: Attributable producer and predecessor evidence
requirements.description: When producer and release-history evidence is collected, deployment-manager shall retain attributable dispositions and shall distinguish first release, comparable predecessor, and unavailable comparison without fabricating a pass.

validation.notes: Preparation tests cover exact typed producer observations and honest first-release, comparable, and unavailable predecessor modes; the server adapter verifies exact published target lineage.

requirements.title: Exact-identity approval and promotion
requirements.description: When independent goal close-out or promotion is requested, deployment-manager shall revalidate the exact review identity and current required evidence and shall refuse any open, stale, regressed, unavailable-required, or mismatched state.

validation.notes: Approval rejects unresolved mechanical or human evidence, stale evidence, expired waivers, and identity mismatch; release handler tests enforce the exact approved identity.

requirements.title: Adaptive agent capability loop
requirements.description: When an agent uses or improves deployment readiness, deployment-manager shall expose discoverable skill roles, bounded governed programs, attributable learning capture, and live measures that route repair to the correct owner and remove superseded workarounds.

validation.notes: The validated usage/improve skill set declares five bounded governed programs, owned measures, failure classes, and attributable learning capture.
